cases.why_not_shipped: no shipped check adopts an imported reservation.

cases.quote: Preserve accounts and hashed-password login, existing bearer tokens, fixture configuration, reservations, references, all completed idempotent request bodies and original responses.

cases.quote: For a creation of a pair, replace the `table_id` change by `table_ids` (from null to the pair).
cases.why_not_shipped: no shipped check reads the history of a combined booking.

cases.quote: For a change involving a pair, use `table_ids` (complete before/after lists) instead of `table_id`.
cases.why_not_shipped: no shipped check amends a combined booking.

cases.quote: A reversed input pair names the same set and is not an amendment on its own.
cases.why_not_shipped: no shipped check re-sends a booked pair in reverse order.

cases.quote: Each real change in `POST /reservation-moves` uses individual PATCH semantics: check the old accepted cutoff, then adopt the resulting date's policy.
cases.why_not_shipped: no shipped check sends a move batch under a published policy.

cases.quote: Per-move `expected_revision` is optional and follows PATCH validation and stale-revision rules.
cases.why_not_shipped: no shipped check sends expected_revision inside a batch.

cases.quote: Each affected series revision increases once, and each changed series occurrence becomes a permanent diner exception.
cases.why_not_shipped: no shipped check moves series occurrences in a batch.

cases.quote: A failed batch or replay changes no revisions, histories or exception flags.
cases.why_not_shipped: no shipped check fails or replays a batch over series occurrences.
